## AEAD encryption functions
# The keysets are those of GoogleSQL's compliance tests: one AES-GCM key, and an AES-GCM key
# followed by two RAW ones.

SELECT AEAD.DECRYPT_STRING(k, AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, 'plaintext', 'abc'), 'abc') FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB') AS k)
=> "plaintext"

SELECT AEAD.DECRYPT_STRING(k, AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, 'жэчыщчыщя', '1234'), '1234') FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('') AS k)
=> "жэчыщчыщя"

SELECT TO_HEX(AEAD.DECRYPT_BYTES(k, AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, b'\x00\x01\x02\x03\x03\xff\xfe\xfd', b'\x00\x01\x02'), b'\x00\x01\x02')) FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB') AS k)
=> "0001020303fffefd"

# Text encrypted as BYTES decrypts to its UTF-8 bytes.
SELECT TO_HEX(AEAD.DECRYPT_BYTES(k, AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, CAST('жэ' AS BYTES), b'abc'), b'abc')) FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB') AS k)
=> "d0b6d18d"

SELECT AEAD.DECRYPT_STRING(k, AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, '', ''), '') FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CNnv5+cHEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIJg18Y4DFqVKes4Acs3h55Fe7yqPrqao+rfu70el0KPRGAEQARjZ7+fnByAB') AS k)
=> ""

SELECT AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, 'plaintext', CAST(NULL AS STRING)) FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB') AS k)
=> null

SELECT AEAD.DECRYPT_BYTES(CAST(NULL AS BYTES), b'', b'')
=> null

# Each call draws a new IV, even with the same arguments, while a WITH clause is evaluated once.
SELECT AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, 'plaintext', 'abc') = AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, 'plaintext', 'abc') FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB') AS k)
=> "false"

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, 'plaintext', 'abc')) FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB') AS k), UNNEST([1, 2, 3])
=> "3"

WITH c AS (SELECT AEAD.ENCRYPT(FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB'), 'plaintext', 'abc') AS x) SELECT x = x FROM c
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.AEAD.DECRYPT_STRING(b'', b'', '')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.AEAD.DECRYPT_BYTES(b'', b'', b'')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.AEAD.DECRYPT_STRING(FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB'), b'123', 'abc')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.AEAD.DECRYPT_STRING(k, AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, 'plaintext', 'abc'), 'different aad') FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB') AS k)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.AEAD.DECRYPT_BYTES(k, AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, b'plaintext', b'abc'), b'different aad') FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB') AS k)
=> null

# Decrypted plaintext that is not UTF-8 is an error for DECRYPT_STRING.
SELECT SAFE.AEAD.DECRYPT_STRING(k, AEAD.ENCRYPT(k, b'\xff\xfe', b'abc'), 'abc') FROM (SELECT FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB') AS k)
=> null

# Answers collected from BigQuery with bqanswers.
SELECT LENGTH(AEAD.ENCRYPT(FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB'), 'plaintext', 'abc'))
=> "42"

SELECT TO_HEX(SUBSTR(AEAD.ENCRYPT(FROM_BASE64('CJmMp4UJEmQKWAowdHlwZS5nb29nbGVhcGlzLmNvbS9nb29nbGUuY3J5cHRvLnRpbmsuQWVzR2NtS2V5EiIaIP7Xj33VJoXuk9KMRwXsjkuDmo5P40WUSaVtJAzyve80GAEQARiZjKeFCSAB'), 'plaintext', 'abc'), 1, 5))
=> "0190a9c619"
